snippet.title: PixReveal Trailer – A free Jackbox style party game to play with friends and colleagues - Trailer
snippet.description:
PixReveal is a free browser game. Highlight is theJackbox Games inspired local party multiplayer. Host a game on the big screen and play with your phones. Guess the pixel art before somebody else does. Use powerups to sabotage your friends. Or play PixReveal in singleplayer mode.

The game is safe for work, perfect to play with colleagues or family. Everybody understands the gameplay within 5 seconds.

PixReveal is abailable now, no login required: pixreveal.com 👈🏻

#pixelart #jackboxgames #partygames #indiegame
